newsitem.title: USA: Total Petroleum arrangement gets court ok.
newsitem.headline: Total Petroleum arrangement gets court ok.

text.p: Total Petroleum (North America) Ltd said Thursday that the Court of Queen's Bench of Alberta has approved the plan of arrangement whereby its common shares will be acquired by a subsidiary of Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp.
It said the Plan will become effective upon filing of the certificate with the Canada Business Corporations Act, but that the deal is still subject to Federal Trade Commission approval.

Total Petroleum refines and markets petroleum products and has refineries in Colorado, Oklahoma and Michigan and marketing activities in the central United States. The Denver-headquartered company employs about 6,400 people.
About 55.5 percent of its common shares are owned by France's Total SA.
